reason: This helper only extracts flag-dependency references from filter groups; the endpoint that copies a flag to multiple target projects is the copy_flags action.
pinned_client builds and returns an httpx.Client (PinnedClient) for a URL that connects only to the validated IPs from the pinned set.

flush_realm_emoji returns early when file_name is None because the emoji is still mid-upload, so it can't have been cached yet, and the handler runs again once file_name is set (per the code comment).
resolve_address picks the shipping address if present, otherwise falls back to the billing address, for the taxable object used in tax calculation.
MessageDict's docstring says it is the core class responsible for marshalling Message objects from the database into the format sent to clients via the Zulip API.
A blank/whitespace query skips searchIssues (which requires a term) and instead queries issues ordered by updatedAt, returning recently updated issues up to the limit.
_default_narrow returns a narrow of the user's default_events_register_stream when no narrow is given and a default stream exists.

RequestVariableConversionError is the JsonableError defined here with code REQUEST_VARIABLE_INVALID and message "Bad value for '{var_name}': {bad_value}", raised when a request parameter value is invalid or cannot be converted.
filter_menu_item_search filters MenuItem querysets by name when a search value is given, and is used as the method for MenuItemFilter.search in GraphQL.
get_comment_body only builds the comment text data and delegates to fill_appropriate_message_content; the final body combining the template with the creator is assembled in get_body.
Its docstring says it computes page_params for the home page load, and it assembles all the params sent to the client.
It decides whether an address is the user's default shipping address by comparing the annotated user_default_shipping_address_pk to the address's pk, and returns None when the annotation is absent.
GCSMediaPrivateStorage uses the private bucket setting (GS_MEDIA_PRIVATE_BUCKET_NAME) and sets custom_endpoint to None, matching the question.
It assembles the list of all auxiliary reader CREATE TABLE statements (events, heatmaps, replay, person, groups, cohorts, channel definitions, raw sessions) used for log_entries joins.
serialize_deliveries converts AlertDelivery receipts into dicts via asdict, the format an alert check stores, matching its docstring.

It classifies a missing person into a day-domain class (grace/seed/boundary/unseeded/post/unattributed) using cumulative per-domain match counts against the membership threshold with a precedence order.
_rule_base_event builds a PromotionEvent for each rule and persists them all with a single PromotionEvent.objects.bulk_create call.
Recipient.label returns the stream name for stream recipients and the display recipient string for direct message groups, which is the conversion to a human-readable name.

When the payload has 'concurrents' and 'siteDetails', it formats a message saying the site has N visitors online, links to the GoSquared account page, and posts it under topic 'GoSquared - <domain>' as a traffic_spike event.
MutedUser.__str__ returns the string 'muter_email -> muted_email', which is the human-readable representation of a mute relationship (used by Django admin).
It raises a ValidationError when delay >= the AUTOMATIC_CHECKOUT_COMPLETION_OLDEST_MODIFIED threshold (in minutes), which is the delay validation against the oldest eligible checkout.
TooManyConcurrentFileDownloads is the custom APIException (HTTP 429) defined for a team exceeding concurrent file download batch exports, and it is raised in create() when the limit is hit.
classify_expr_type is a function that classifies a type's precision; the visitor detecting SQL shape pathologies like conversion wrappers and nullable comparisons is SQLShapeCollector.
It builds the JWT payload for the new access token, combining user identity (sub, email, user_uuid), organization (org_id, app_org) and granted scopes (scope).

It sends the events that follow a bot ownership transfer: a user update for everyone, a bot delete for the previous owner, and a bot add for the new owner. It does not cover the DB change or the audit log.
TaxCountryConfigurationDeleteErrorCode is the enum of error codes (graphql_error, invalid, not_found) for the delete-country-tax-configuration mutation.
HyphenatedPropertyDetector visits Sub arithmetic operations and flags field chains like a.b - c with no spaces as hyphenated property names, emitting a bracket-notation error.
It checks data.size against the realm's max file upload size (rejecting with 413) and then calls check_upload_within_quota for the realm's storage quota.
It maps each custom profile field id to its position in the given order, saves that as the field's order, and notifies the realm.
It is the worker class assigned to the 'email_senders' queue, which processes and sends queued emails (logic inherited from EmailSendingWorker).
report_canary_results_sync aggregates outcome counts, pushes Prometheus gauges via the pushgateway, and calls _send_slack_alert when divergences exist.
It raises an error if the webhook has no subscription query, then builds a SubscriptionQuery and raises a validation error if it is not valid.
TransactionEventReportErrorCode enumerates the error codes (invalid, not_found, incorrect_details, already_exists, required) returned when reporting a transaction event.
It calls stripe.PaymentIntent.capture with amount_to_capture on an existing payment intent, capturing a specific amount from a previously authorized intent.
AccountSetDefaultAddress is the mutation that lets an authenticated user set one of their own addresses as default billing or shipping, verifying ownership first.
PageSortField is the enum that defines the available sort options (TITLE, SLUG, VISIBILITY, CREATED_AT, PUBLISHED_AT, RANK, etc.) for pages in the GraphQL API.
It directly executes the UPDATE on zerver_usermessage setting flags | 1 (the unread-marking flag) for the given user message ids.

kill_switch_overrides resolves the kill switch level for the team and returns the max_execution_time, max_threads, max_memory_usage and max_bytes_to_read ceilings from the settings table for that level.
dictfetchall zips cursor.description column names with each row from fetchall() to return a list of dicts keyed by column name.
The candidate is just an abstract Meta class on BaseTranslationType; the attribute filtering by translatable input type is done in get_translatable_attribute_values.
_parse_email_fixture checks fixture_path.endswith('.json') to choose the JSON parser, otherwise parses raw email with BytesParser.
__init__ calls get_connection() and keeps it as self.connection only if it is a PersistentSMTPEmailBackend, otherwise sets None, which is exactly the persistent-connection decision.
get_safe_settings returns an empty dict when settings.PRODUCTION is true (omitting settings from reports) and otherwise returns the masked safe settings in development.
It first loads promotion-updated orders/lines, then obtains the plugin manager and calls process_order_prices to recalculate order prices.
get_added_label_body only builds the message body for add/remove label actions; the logic that determines the specific updateCard subtype is in get_proper_action.
The function directly returns the cache key format f"realm_emoji:{realm_id}" used for caching a realm's custom emoji.
It substitutes every URL in a free-text name with its host, which strips the webhook credential path, and the display-name code calls it to do so.

It builds the per-variant expected, predicted and recorded counts that feed the selection (capture-side) and reassignment (assignment-side) split, but the subtraction itself happens in VariantGap's properties.
It filters products to those with at least one variant whose channel listing in the given channel slug has price within lte/gte bounds, via nested Exists subqueries.
CheckoutDeliveryByIdLoader is a DataLoader that batch-loads CheckoutDelivery objects by their UUID id using in_bulk.
collapse_untrusted only collapses whitespace in untrusted prompt text; routing between the Go ai-gateway and Python gateway is decided in build_enrichment_client via resolve_ai_gateway_config().
clean_payment raises a ValidationError with PAYMENT_MISSING and the message 'There's no payment associated with the order.' when the payment is None.
QueryRetrievalError is the custom exception raised in QueryStatusManager._get_results when the Redis get of stored async query results fails.
_manifest_field converts a TrinoManifestColumn into a typed DatabaseField via _FIELD_TYPES and raises TrinoLoweringError for unsupported types or empty names.
The property reads the LOCAL_PATH_CLEANING_FILTERS setting, which holds the custom local path-cleaning rules (parsing JSON strings if needed).
get_proper_action returns None for updateBoard events whose old prefs contain 'background', so background-only changes are skipped (process_board_action then returns None).
handle selects the earliest due ScheduledEmail with select_for_update(skip_locked=True) inside transaction.atomic, claiming the next job for delivery.
It decodes each global ID to its pk via from_global_id_or_error and checks that every ID has the same type, raising GraphQLError on mismatches or unresolvable IDs.

ready() registers the post_delete signal handler delete_thumbnail_image for Thumbnail, which is the wiring that causes the stored image file to be removed when a record is deleted, though the deletion logic itself lives in signals.py.
get_client_cache_key only builds a cache key string from a client name; clearing/resetting the in-memory cache is done by clear_client_cache.
It computes each team's effective retention via COALESCE of the team-level config and the organization-level default, joining team, team config and org config tables.
It decodes a UTF-8 bytes value by splitting on '|' into a state string and an integer changed_at timestamp.
list_alert_words is the view handler that returns the user's current alert words as JSON.
_parse_run_ids converts the raw --run-id strings to UUID objects and raises CommandError if any is not a valid UUID.
It dedupes and sorts the user IDs, joins them as a comma-separated string, and returns the SHA-1 hexdigest, which is the deterministic hash used as huddle_hash.
VoucherTranslate is the GraphQL mutation class with description 'Creates/updates translations for a voucher.'
BooleanAttributeHandler.pre_save_value builds the value name as '<attribute name>: Yes/No' in defaults when saving a boolean attribute value to an instance.
clean_input calls check_for_duplicates on add_attributes and remove_attributes and records a DUPLICATED_INPUT_ITEM error under 'attributes' when the same attribute appears in both lists.
get_instance only fetches the order and checks it is a draft; the recalculation decisions are in clean_shipping_method and should_invalidate_prices.
It decides whether first/last is enforced by checking whether `edges` is among the selected fields (via _edges_in_selections); if edges isn't queried, enforcement is disabled.

register_success only records a 'total' event in storage; the recovery success count (50) is defined by BREAKER_BOARD_SUCCESS_COUNT_RECOVERY and used in reached_half_open_target_success_count, not here.
to_internal_value validates the filters payload is a dict and instantiates PropertyGroupFilterValue (pydantic), raising a ValidationError if it does not conform to the schema.
get_idle_time returns time.time() minus the most recent activity or workflow execution time, i.e. seconds since the worker last executed anything.
display_list formats values with commas/'and' and summarizes extras as 'and N other(s)' when exceeding display_limit.
The Meta class only holds mutation metadata (description, permissions, error type, doc category); the delete and bulk_create of granted refund lines happens in process_update_for_granted_refund.
perform_mutation catches ValidationError, builds an error response via handle_errors, and sets its result to FAILED_TO_DELIVER before returning it.
validate_manifest_url uses AppURLValidator to check the manifest URL format and raises CommandError if it is incorrect. handle() calls it before fetching the manifest and installing the app.
It queries the issue's fingerprints ordered by created_at and returns the oldest one, documented as the stable link across merges.
handle gets the realm, looks up the user by email and realm via get_user, then prompts for the password twice, validates it, and retries up to 3 times.
add_arguments defines the --all flag whose help text says it prints all configuration settings of the realms.
It loops over USER_SYNC_FIELDS, compares cloud values to local user attributes, and applies updates via setattr and save unless dry_run.

OrderCancel.perform_mutation orchestrates the full API cancel flow: fetches the order, checks permissions, validates via clean_order_cancel, calls cancel_order, and deactivates gift cards in one transaction.
GenerateDigestDataWorkflow orchestrates the dashboard, event definition, experiment, survey and feature flag lookup generators before digests are sent.
RemoteActivityPlanData is a dataclass with current_status, current_plan_name, annual_revenue, and rate fields, bundling exactly the subscription billing info described for remote installations.
_expiry_date computes the earliest future date the person's in-window event count drops below min_count: the newest-first accumulated critical day plus window_days + 1.
clean_actions is a field_validator on 'actions' that lowercases each action in the webhook response schema.
It canonicalizes the timezone string, validates it with ZoneInfo, and returns the canonical string or an empty string if unrecognized.
_evict_orphans deletes IntegrationRepositoryCacheEntry rows for the team whose full_name isn't in the valid (light-cache) repository set.
perform_mutation removes the discount from the order line, emits order_line_discount_removed_event, and calls invalidate_order_prices(order, save=True) in one transaction.
Meta defines a UniqueConstraint on Lower("name") and realm with condition is_archived=False, enforcing case-insensitive unique folder names per realm for non-archived folders.
verify checks for the X-PandaDoc-Signature header and, if absent, falls back to verifying with the 'signature' query parameter from request.GET.
FileFormat is just a TextChoices enum of Parquet/JSONLines; the function resolving a file part id/index to a BatchExportFileDownload is _get_file_download_for_run.
It iterates report_args_history in reversed order (newest to oldest), calling salvage_report on each and returning the first non-None report.
It expires the previously bound PENDING ChangeRequest (sets state to EXPIRED) when re-gating a changed payload yields no CR or a different one.
The handler catches SuppressedEventError from topic_and_body and returns json_success(request) without sending any message, which is the silent-ignore behavior.
The candidate is the abstract base class with only customer and fixed_price fields; the license-count retrieval is the CustomerPlan.licenses method, not this class.
visit_function compiles a function declaration, not a BETWEEN expression; the BETWEEN compilation with null/undefined checks is in visit_between_expr.
flock takes an already-open file object (or fd), acquires LOCK_EX or LOCK_SH depending on the shared flag, and releases the lock after the with block.
is_postwh_host decides whether a host belongs to the PostHog Warehouse domain by lowercasing it, stripping a trailing dot, and checking for the '.postwh.com' suffix.
It counts OrganizationMembership rows for the organization, filtering to active users and excluding emails ending with INTERNAL_BOT_EMAIL_SUFFIX.
OrderReturnFulfillmentLineInput is the input type for specifying fulfilled (fulfillment) lines, with ID and quantity, to return from an order.

add_user_group loops over GROUP_PERMISSION_SETTINGS, parses each provided setting value, validates it via access_user_group_for_setting, and passes the resulting group_settings_map to check_add_user_group when creating the group.
The candidate is only the Meta class of the input type (doc_category setting); the channel selection logic (first active channel by slug) lives in OrderSettingsUpdate.perform_mutation.
_lower_by_name_operators reorders each BY NAME branch's columns to match the first branch's column names via _permute_set_operand, then strips the BY NAME suffix.
get_payment_config returns the Razorpay public key (connection_params['public_key']) as an 'api_key' field when the plugin is active.
